quickCards.title: Leave With The Record Pouch
quickCards.summary: Grab the smallest current record set that answers identity, insurance, and contact questions after you leave home.
quickCards.bodyMarkdown:
## Grab
- Take the record pouch before hunting for extras.
- Confirm it includes identity, insurance, medical, and contact essentials.

## Check
- Make sure another adult knows where it came from.
- Keep it with the go-bag instead of burying it in loose supplies.

## Update Later
- Replace stale cards and old addresses after the event.
- Keep a note of what was missing so the pouch improves next time.

quickCards.title: Insurance Photo Sweep
quickCards.summary: Use short repeatable room and item photos so later insurance questions start with current evidence instead of memory.
quickCards.bodyMarkdown:
## Walk The Space
- Photograph each room from a repeatable angle.
- Capture major equipment and high-value items clearly.

## Keep It Consistent
- Use dates and broad item descriptions that will still make sense later.
- Store the newest sweep where you can retrieve it fast.

## Repeat After Change
- Update after purchases, remodels, or a move.
- Remove outdated sets only after the newer one is confirmed available.
